description:
One county's upcoming tax or sheriff sales (next 21 days), per sale date: properties listed, pre-checked,
        and how many carry an open or second mortgage, a lien, a lis pendens, open code violations, a high risk score,
        or came back clear. `state`: two-letter code; `county`: county name ('Philadelphia', 'Harris', 'Montgomery').
        Counts only. Only counties HeritageDeed title-searches (list_coverage).
name: auction_precheck_summary
